items.title: Order pool live · 5 HMC test completed (rc11h)
items.summary: Production useful-PoW order order-live-5hmc-202605251816: prepaid 5 HMC (5×1 HMC reward), minimal WASM gate, completed 5/5 in ~2 minutes. Escrow fee 0.25 HMC, burn 0.5 HMC. items.title: Release 0.1.0-rc11g: Windows OpenCL worker (AMD RX 580 full GPU)
